_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-04 (Steam capture 20260804154427 (art), 154655-154704 (loadout)). The page leads with the in-game class name, which is the title the loadout screen shows; the model designation rides underneath. One page covers both faction variants; both models were captured, NATO on 2026-08-04 15:43-15:48 and Pax Armata at 16:59-17:00. TBD is deliberate everywhere: a slot screen names every option in its row but describes only the highlighted one, so most options are named and not yet described. The Anti-Air Missile description reproduces the in-game typo "enage" for "engage". Quoted as published, same rule the log uses for EA's patch-note typos.
name: Attack Helicopter

options.name: Light Rockets
options.description: Unguided rockets capable of firing larger volleys but providing less damage per projectile. Effective against light vehicles and infantry.

options.name: Anti-Air
options.title: Anti-Air Missile
options.description: A missile designed to enage aircraft. Requires lock-on before launch, after which the missile will guide itself to the target unless intercepted by countermeasures. Capable of faster and longer range lock-ons for targets that have been marked with the Laser Designator or Tracer Dart.

options.name: Emergency Repair
options.description: Repairs damaged vehicles. Can only be activated when the vehicle is in a low-health state.

options.name: Thermal Optics
options.description: Enables thermal vision for the attack helicopter gunner while zoomed.
